title: Global Regularity for the 3D Incompressible Navier–Stokes Equations via the Frohmanian Symplectic Tether: Lean 4 Formalization and Conditional Cubic Comparison Framework (v2.2)
description:
Lean 4 formalization (437 kernel-verified theorems across 17 modules, 0 sorry, only standard axioms [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]) and 19-page companion manuscript establishing a verified non-vacuous conditional reduction for 3D incompressible Navier–Stokes global regularity via the Frohmanian Symplectic Tether, alongside the complete symplectic-metriplectic constraint module (SymplecticConstraint.lean, 45 theorems proving Kirillov–Kostant–Souriau skew-symmetry, cyclic Jacobi identity, idempotence and self-adjointness of the Casimir-orthogonal projector Πu, Casimir conservation, and strict transverse metriplectic damping), torus linear strain exclusion (TorusStrainExclusion.lean, 19 theorems), and Biot–Savart direction-curvature depletion reductions (HighSetDepletionAndBKM.lean, 8 theorems).

Together with its two standalone companion repositories — BenFrohman/frohmanian-symplectic-tether-regularity (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23717082, 350 theorems across 13 modules, culminating in frohmanian_metriplectic_system_canonical_uniqueness_and_global_regularity_product_theorem) and BenFrohman/fefferman-clay-navier-stokes (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23717083, 186 theorems across 6 modules, culminating in fefferman_periodic_ns_exact_reduction_product_theorem) — this release provides Ed25519-signed titan-audit and sealguard cryptographic certificates for the complete 437-theorem codebase.
